items.title: What Does Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Gaining A Top 14 AI Supercomputer Mean?
items.summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (NYSE:HPE) and AMD co-designed the new Lux AI supercomputer cluster for the U.S. Department of Energy's Genesis Mission. Lux debuted at No. 14 on the global TOP500 supercomputer list, marking its first appearance for the Genesis Mission facility. The Genesis Mission lab is the first DOE national laboratory to deploy HPE Networking solutions alongside cloud-like access for AI workloads.
